title: auggie
excerpt: you'll always be august to me.
body:
you'll always be august to me.

your paws clacking on the cocoa-stained
floor like pebbles kicked up against the
aluminum hull of my car before a good hike.
scurrying like the shine across golden fields
of grain when we try to outrun the wind at
sunset.

your fur rising out the window when the light
turns green like warm air rushing up through
my hair from the canyon below us when
we've made it to the silence at the
viewpoint.

even on the coldest nights when the suns
glow evades me

you radiate like the summer never left.
